code_review.summary: Code review approved the eventing fixup and verified both prior HIGH findings resolved. The only LOW finding was evidence updated_at earlier than created_at; fixed in this evidence update.

review_fixups.finding: Topic fields were public and TopicRegistry::register did not revalidate invariants.
review_fixups.fix: Topic fields are private, Topic has read-only accessors, TopicRegistry::register calls topic.validate(), and a regression constructs an internal invalid topic and verifies registration rejects it.

review_fixups.finding: FileOutboxStore could not persist false-to-true published transitions for already-persisted records.
review_fixups.fix: FileOutboxStore now appends v1-published status events, replays them into Outbox state, rejects true-to-false/divergent prefixes, and has a persist-mark-published-reload regression.
